definition: The European Association for Artificial Intelligence (EurAI), formerly the European Coordinating Committee for Artificial Intelligence (ECCAI), is a European organization representing national artificial intelligence societies and research communities.
details: Its aim is to promote the study, research, and application of artificial intelligence (AI) in Europe.

explainer.lead: The European Association for Artificial Intelligence, or EurAI, brings national AI societies and research communities under a European umbrella. Its role is to encourage the study, research, and application of AI across Europe.

tiers.eli5: EurAI is like a club for other clubs: national groups interested in AI are represented together at the European level. The association encourages people to learn about AI, research it, and put it to practical use. It was formerly called ECCAI.
tiers.practitioner: EurAI is relevant as a representative organization, not as a library, model, or technical standard to integrate into a system. Engineers should not expect it to provide an implementation or prescribe engineering tools; its stated remit is promoting AI study, research, and application through European representation.
tiers.paperLevel: EurAI is defined organizationally as a European association representing national AI societies and AI research communities, with scope S = {study, research, application of AI}. It was formerly named the European Coordinating Committee for Artificial Intelligence (ECCAI). Its remit is representational and promotional rather than a formal technical method with measurable outputs.
